description: Add Angular UI components for finding status management: a status dropdown per finding row in the scan detail view, a justification modal for risk_accepted status, and status filter controls in the findings list.
steps: Add FindingStatusUpdate interface and FindingStatusEntry interface to ui/src/app/models/sbom.model.ts. FindingStatusUpdate: { status: string, justification?: string, purl: string, expires_at?: string }. FindingStatusEntry: { id: number, version_id: number, vuln_id: string, purl: string, status: string, justification?: string, updated_by: number, updated_at: string, expires_at?: string }.
Add updateFindingStatus(scanId: number, vulnId: string, body: FindingStatusUpdate) and listFindingStatuses(scanId: number, statusFilter?: string[]) methods to ui/src/app/services/sbom.service.ts.

Update ui/src/app/pages/sbom/sbom-scan-detail.component.ts to: (1) Add a status column to the All Findings table with a dropdown select element showing all valid statuses. (2) Add a status filter row above the table with checkboxes/buttons for each status. (3) On status change, show a justification modal/dialog (required for risk_accepted, optional for others). (4) Call the API to persist the status change. (5) Load existing statuses on page init and merge them with the findings display. (6) Use i18n with @@syntax for all new user-facing text.
Add a 'suppressed count' badge in the scan summary section showing how many findings are suppressed/false_positive (hidden from the default view).
acceptance_criteria: Each finding row in the scan detail table shows a status dropdown with all valid statuses
Changing status to risk_accepted triggers a justification input (required)
Status filter controls allow filtering the findings list by status
The service methods for updating and listing statuses are implemented
All new user-facing text uses i18n with @@syntax
A badge shows the count of suppressed/false_positive findings
The component compiles without TypeScript errors
